task_1.normalization: Lowercase alphabetic words (including internal apostrophes); punctuation and numeric tokens are excluded. Alphabetic chat-event terms such as JOIN and PART remain part of the corpus.

task_4.least_method: Sort by ascending frequency, then alphabetically to resolve ties; take the first 30 words.
task_4.middle_method: Choose the 30 frequencies nearest the geometric midpoint between the minimum and maximum observed frequencies.

task_6.sentence_unit: Each NPS Chat post is treated as a sentence-like unit.
